promises.label: FY2026 EBIT guidance
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: Our reported 13.4 % EBIT for the quarter and our plan to register a 15% EBIT in Q4 will lead us to the 14% EBIT guidance for FY2026 .

promises.label: FCF on a sustained basis
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: Finally, free cash flow for the quarter came in at 110%, significantly ahead of our guidance of around 70% to 80% FCF on a sustained basis.

promises.label: Q4 EBIT
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: our plan to register a 15% EBIT in Q4 will lead us to the 14% EBIT guidance for FY2026

promises.label: Robust growth
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: set us up for continued robust growth performance not just in FY2026, but in FY2027 and hopefully beyond.

promises.label: Encora transaction expenses
promises.speaker: Saurabh Goel
promises.quote: we are expecting expenses associated with the transaction included integration and funding expenses over the course of next two quarters to the extent of $ 10 – $15 million.

promises.label: No dilution of EPS in FY27
promises.speaker: Saurabh Goel
promises.quote: The guidance related to no dilution of EPS in FY27 of the combined business stays intact even after this debt.

reported.label: Q3 sequential CC growth
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: In Q3, we registered a growth of 4.4 % in CC terms, and our year -to-date dollar revenue growth is now 32.8%.

reported.label: YTD dollar revenue growth
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: In Q3, we registered a growth of 4.4 % in CC terms, and our year -to-date dollar revenue growth is now 32.8%.

reported.label: Reported EBIT margin
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: it is pertinent to note that our reported 13.4 % EBIT for the quarter and our plan to register a 15% EBIT in Q4 will lead us to the 14% EBIT guidance for FY2026 .

reported.label: Free cash flow to normalized PAT
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Finally, free cash flow for the quarter came in at 110%, significantly ahead of our guidance of around 70% to 80% FCF on a sustained basis.

reported.label: Order intake
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: The total order intake during Q3 was $593 million. It was almost within kissing distance of $600 million.

reported.label: Executable order book
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: The executable order book, which reflects the total value of locked orders over the next 12 months stands at a record $1.72 billion .

reported.label: Revenue
reported.speaker: Saurabh Goel
reported.quote: We are pleased to report revenue of INR 41,881 Mn in Q3 of FY26 reflecting a sequential growth of 4.4 % in CC terms and 5.1% in INR terms.

reported.label: Capital expenditure
reported.speaker: Saurabh Goel
reported.quote: Capital expenditure for the quarter stood at $3 million.
